recipes.name: Fluffy Pancakes
steps: Beat eggs with milk, then stir into the dry mix until just combined.
Cook ladlefuls on a buttered pan until bubbles form, flip and cook 1 more minute.

recipes.name: Tomato and Egg Stir-fry
steps: Beat eggs with a pinch of salt and scramble softly; set aside.
Stir-fry tomato wedges until juicy, add sugar and salt.
Return eggs, toss, and finish with spring onion.

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer chicken with onion in water for 40 minutes.
Remove chicken, shred meat, return to pot.
Add sliced carrots and celery, cook 10 minutes.
Add noodles and cook until tender. Season.
